_about: Paper-explainer SFX library. Each effect is generated via audioldm-s-full-v2 and stored as MP3 (96 kbps, 2s, stereo). The engine in scripts/sound/ reads this file to build the runtime registry. The bundled 19-file media-use library (UI/motion-graphic) is NOT used here — paper-explainer needs paper textures, not UI clicks.

pencil-write-1.description: Soft pencil writing on paper, gentle scratchy stroke. The primary 'write' texture — fires during text-reveal animations.

pencil-write-loop-1.description: Continuous pencil writing loop, sustained scratchy texture. Loops under long writing animations.

pencil-draw-loop-1.description: Pencil drawing a smooth line, continuous stroke, even pressure. Background texture for SVG stroke-draw animations.

marker-swipe-1.description: Highlighter marker swiping across paper, soft squeak. Fires on .hl (yellow highlight) and underline animations.

paper-place-1.description: Soft paper being placed on a desk, light thump. Fires when comparison cards / boxes / callouts land.

soft-whoosh-1.description: Gentle air whoosh, paper sliding, subtle. Fires on section reveal and scene transitions.

soft-impact-1.description: Soft impact accent, paper on paper, satisfying but quiet. Fires on emphasized reveals and circled conclusions.

chime-bright-1.description: Clear bright bell chime, single high note, sparkling. Fires on important-value reveals and final conclusions.
